title: A return that needs a clarifying question, ending in a refund
why: The agent asks before it writes, then refunds the order the customer named. Deciding to ask is policy.should_clarify; phrasing the question is the model. Converted from golden_transcript_return_flow, conversation id and all, so the idempotency key it pinned is the one this file pins.

turns.customer: I'd like to return a book.
turns.reply: Sure — which book would you like to return? 1) Godel, Escher, Bach (BK-1042)  2) The Pragmatic Programmer (BK-0987)

turns.customer: The Escher one — the cover is torn.
turns.reply: Done — Godel, Escher, Bach (BK-1042) was delivered on July 18, inside the 30-day return window, so I've issued a refund of $22.50 to your original payment method. It should post within 5 business days.

known_gaps.why: _refund_approved promises 'within 5 business days' from the template. No fact on the event carries the 5, and the narration prompt forbids a hosted narrator from inventing exactly that kind of promise, so the two providers cannot say the same thing. Fix is a refund_posting service level carried as a fact.
